name: dump
syntax: dump(var [, output] [, label] [, top] [, expand] [, abort])
description: Alias for writeDump(): outputs the elements, variables and values of most kinds of CFML objects. Useful for debugging. Supports the named arguments var, output (browser, console or a file path), label, top, expand and abort; output="console" sends a plain-text dump to the server console and output to a file appends plain text.

params.name: output
params.description: Where to send the dump: browser (default), console (server log) or a file path.

params.name: expand
params.description: Whether complex values are expanded (default true).

params.name: abort
params.description: True to abort immediately after displaying the dump.
